score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men's ministry not explicitly confirmed on website at time of research, though PCA churches typically have strong small group/discipleship frameworks.

churches.assessment: West End Presbyterian is a PCA congregation in Richmond's West End — and PCA means a lot here. The Presbyterian Church in America is one of the most theologically rigorous denominations in America: inerrancy of Scripture, Westminster Confession of Faith, male-only elders, faith-alone soteriology, and complementarian theology are all baked into the PCA constitution. Rev. Steven Shelby leads a church with a clearly stated mission: 'make followers of Jesus who bring the Gospel to bear on every facet of life and culture.' The staff includes associate pastors for youth and neighborhood outreach, suggesting a full-orbed ministry. For any man seeking a doctrinally robust, Gospel-centered, Word-saturated church home in Richmond, West End Presbyterian belongs at the top of the list.

churches.assessment: Church of the Incarnation is an ACNA church plant serving western Henrico County, meeting at Gayton Road Christian Church on Sundays at 9am. The Anglican Church in North America (ACNA) formed in 2009 when conservative Anglicans broke from the progressive Episcopal Church (TEC) over Scripture authority, sexuality, and leadership. ACNA holds to the 39 Articles, male clergy, traditional Anglican liturgy, and biblical sexual ethics — a clean break from TEC's progressive drift. The church's stated core values are compelling: 'Biblical teaching for the head and the heart; Spiritual formation through liturgy and sacrament; A life of prayer together; Gospel care for those in need; Discipleship of the next generation.' This is Word-and-sacrament Anglicanism done right. Strong option for men who love liturgical worship rooted in Scripture.

churches.pastor: The Very Rev. W. Scott Thompson (Rector)
churches.denomination: Reformed Episcopal Church (REC) / Anglican Church in North America (ACNA)

score_notes.mens_discipleship: No dedicated men's ministry confirmed on website at time of research.
score_notes.denominational: Reformed Episcopal Church (REC) — Anglican Church in North America (ACNA) — conservative Anglican body, not TEC.

churches.assessment: St. Jude's Anglican Church is an REC/ACNA congregation in Richmond — and the Reformed Episcopal Church is one of the most doctrinally rigorous Anglican bodies in existence. Founded in 1873 as a protest against Catholic ritualism in the Anglican tradition, the REC holds to Protestant soteriology (justification by faith alone), Reformation Anglican standards (39 Articles, Book of Common Prayer), male-only clergy, and traditional biblical ethics. Very Rev. W. Scott Thompson leads a congregation described as 'a traditional congregation focused on Jesus Christ, His Gospel, and worship through Word and Sacrament.' This is exactly the kind of clarity men committed to Reformed orthodoxy need: no ambiguity on gender, no denominational drift, no social justice crowding out the Gospel. The REC/ACNA dual affiliation means accountability in both the richest Reformed Anglican tradition and the broader ACNA network. One of the strongest options for any man who loves liturgy, Reformed soteriology, and biblical authority.
churches.gender_detail: REC/ACNA ordains male clergy only; Reformed Episcopal Church is among the most doctrinally conservative Anglican bodies
